Title: HTC-28112: RS485 - Flow control
Purpose: Check if the RS-485 interface has flow control signals to avoid the echo reading in half-duplex architectures.

1.Expected: When transmitting data through UART_0_TX, RS485_DE and !RS485_RE should be high (3.3V).

2.Expected: When receiving data through UART_0_RX, RS485_DE and !RS485_RE should be low (0V).
